Clicking Restart or New Game immediately preempts, clears any pending timers, and discards older requests without waiting for in-flight responses. Legal movements that collide horizontally with walls or settled blocks result in standard no-ops returning HTTP 200 OK. Legal downward movements that collide trigger piece locking, row clearing, and spawning, returning HTTP 200 OK.

Prevented accidental reset of state during internal reconstruction, ensuring a dirty scored state is preserved.
